full_prompt_en: A square, painterly architectural scene shows a monumental white building with gold ornament rising above broad outdoor steps and a shallow reflecting pool. A blue sky with large soft white clouds fills the upper background, while the building occupies most of the center and left. Its façade is composed of bold rectangular masses and tall white piers, with narrow bands of warm gold decoration running beneath rooflines and across projecting ledges. Two high side sections carry long green-and-gold ornamental panels, their vertical symmetry framing a deep central entrance. Between them, darker window bands and balconies recede beneath layered horizontal cornices. Green foliage spills from several upper ledges and gathers in planted strips along the base, softening the rigid geometry. To the right, a simpler pale building stands behind the main structure, its window rows giving the public space a surrounding city context. The broad stairway rises from the lower middle into the entrance, narrowing in perspective toward the doors. Small dark figures are scattered on the stairs, at the top landing, and along the lower left pavement, giving a clear human scale to the large façade. A rectangular turquoise pool sits in the lower right foreground, its lightly rippled surface reflecting fragments of the pale walls and sky. The lower edge is a cool gray paved street, separated from the sunlit steps and water by a subtle horizontal boundary. Fine, somewhat broken paint marks describe windows, plants, and distant people, while the main architectural shapes remain clean and legible. Sunlight from the upper left brightens the white walls and gilded details, leaving modest cool shadows in recesses and below balconies. The overall composition combines a formal, symmetrical building front with moving figures, foliage, and reflective water in a clear blue, white, green, and gold palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带绘画笔意的建筑景象呈现一座饰有金色纹样的纪念性白色建筑，下方是宽阔室外阶梯和一方浅映水池。蓝天与大片柔软白云占据上部背景，建筑则占据中央和左侧大部分。立面由鲜明的矩形体量与高耸白色壁柱组成，屋顶线下和突出的檐口上有狭长的暖金色装饰带。两侧高立的部分各有一块绿色与金色相间的长形饰板，其竖向对称围住深处的中央入口。饰板之间，较暗的窗带与阳台在层叠的水平檐口下向内退进。绿色植物从几处上层台面垂落，也聚在底部种植带里，柔化生硬的几何形。右侧一座更简朴的浅色建筑立在主体后方，成排窗户给公共场所带来周围城市的环境感。宽台阶从画面下方中央向入口升起，透视中逐渐收窄到门前。小小的深色人影散布在阶梯、顶部平台和左下方铺地上，给宏大的立面提供明确的人体尺度。右下前景是一方长方形青绿色水池，微皱的水面映出浅色墙面与天空的片段。下边缘是冷灰色铺装街道，与受日照的阶梯和水面之间由一条细微的水平分界隔开。细小而略断续的笔痕描出窗户、植物和远处人影，主体建筑形体仍保持干净、可辨。阳光从左上方照亮白墙和镀金细节，在凹入处与阳台下留下适度的冷影。整体构图以正式、对称的建筑正面结合移动的人群、植物和反光水面，呈现清澈的蓝、白、绿与金色组合。
style_prompt_en: The architectural painting emphasizes disciplined geometric masses, ornamental linear accents, and a lightly worked, sunlit surface. Pale ivory and white planes dominate, while gold bands and muted green details give the otherwise restrained design a measured richness. Hard structural edges remain readable, but small broken strokes in secondary areas prevent the image from feeling mechanically smooth. Open blue and cream tones create an airy upper field; cooler gray and turquoise areas stabilize the lower portion. Repeating verticals and horizontal cornices build a formal rhythm, with modest irregularity in texture and detail introducing human scale. Bright daylight touches broad planes directly and leaves shallow cool shadows in recesses, so volume is legible without heavy drama. The overall effect is elegant, ordered, luminous, and gently painterly.
style_prompt_zh: 这种建筑绘画强调有纪律的几何体量、装饰性线条强调和经轻微手工处理的日照表面。浅象牙色与白色平面占主导，金色饰带和低饱和绿色细节赋予原本克制的设计有分寸的华丽。坚实的结构边缘仍清晰可辨，次要区域的断续小笔触却让图像免于机械光滑。开阔的蓝色和奶油色在上部形成通透色域，偏冷灰与青绿色稳定下方。重复竖线与水平檐线建立正式节奏，肌理和细部的适度不规则带入人的尺度。明亮日光直接触及宽阔平面，在凹处留下浅浅冷影，使体积清楚而不显沉重。整体效果优雅、有序、明亮且带轻柔绘画感。
theme_en: A white and gold civic building above a broad staircase and reflecting pool
theme_zh: 一座白金相间的公共建筑位于宽阔阶梯和映水池上方
name: Vienna Secession
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
